title: woo seeco silayti dabaanitte
intro: Inkih tan qasriino qagitak sooleh yan rooci cubbus, ken miraacisuh faatacimeh wadirih hoxat yan fidga luk. bool karmoomih, farmo cinnimteh, anqasak, kee bayteh—takkay immay macal masoolinna. Ellecaboh, kaxxa cisab yemeete, kee dubuk dago mari safarte wadih xaqut ta digga le rooci. Atu tama muuci Qur'aanak baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu sinni gital bayte ummattah takkaawisah ruube.
Anu qafuuta gorrisaanam kee ken qellatak wadirih yadaaroonuh ken arcibiseh, takkay immay oson wadir yuduureenih.
Yallih amrih gubat, yi ummatta wagtak yoo anqasak sugte wak kaxxa merraytu xise.
Anu inni Rabbih seeco abeh soole sinnim—ellecabol usuk gacsa abeeh, lee qaraanak caxittaama.
Anu weeqi lee baaxok dagal tawqe wak yaamine mara lih markabat koreh.
Anu darrel raaqeh yan numuh weeqeh, qalel dabboh gexaanam essereeh, takkay immay amri naharal elle taturteh.
